heading: Fixture format
text:
## Fixture format [RCTS.1]

The conformance suite is the set of fixtures at `specs/conformance/`
([LTES.8.3.1]); a runtime conforms by passing it ([LCON.1.1]). This section
specifies what a fixture is, so that every runtime's harness reads the same
fixture the same way. The obligations the fixtures test are the conformance
categories ([LCON.2], [LCON.3], [LCON.4]).
